ev.q: Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey
I havent been this immersed in a deckbuilding game ever since
blends the deckbuilding roguelike, escape-room style puzzles, and psychological horror
the deeper the story got the more enthralled with it I was
Act 3 kills any interest I have in the game
both the better elements and the atmosphere disappear with the introduction of act 2
still have tons of content I can sink myself into
